title: Project custom Theme resource throwing errors on reading Autoload/Static scripts
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.7.rc3, 4.6.2.stable
Not reproducible: Did not found a working version.

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc3 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8115) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.05 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Theme set in Project Settings -> General -> GUI -> Theme -> Custom. If this theme resource contains reference to another resource, like styleboxflat, that has func _init(), Autoload, or Static references it will throw errors/freeze DURING COMPILE ONLY. (No issues unless you click play)

I expect to be able to override func _init and use autoload/static script values without getting errors on runtime when having a script extend StyleBoxFlat.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Click play. See Debugger errors (Happens because of func _init() or accessing a static class)
2. Open StyleBoxFlatInit.gd, uncomment line 14 and click play. see that program halts (happens because of trying to access autoload script)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e1b8c834-4ce6-4b31-8fee-e6a7c9e3699f

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[theme-init-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29027920/theme-init-test.zip)
